# Snowflake generator behaviour. "gen" starts a new generator.
#   gen <machine_id> <epoch_ms>
#   next <clock_ms[,clock_ms...]> <expected>
#   fill <count> <clock_ms>
# next: the clock returns the listed readings in order, then repeats the last one.
#       expected is the id, or "error" (the call fails and the generator is unchanged).
# fill: calls next <count> times with a fixed clock; each call succeeds with a larger id.
gen 7 1288834974657
next 1750000000000 1934266310456274944
next 1750000000000 1934266310456274945
next 1750000000001 1934266310460469248
next 1749999999995 1934266310460469249
fill 4094 1750000000001
next 1750000000001,1750000000001,1750000000002 1934266310464663552
next 1750000000002 1934266310464663553
gen 3 1288834974657
next 1750000000000 1934266310456258560
fill 4095 1750000000000
next 1749999999997,1749999999997,1750000000000,1750000000001 1934266310460452864
gen 0 1288834974657
next 1288834974656 error
next 1288834974657 0
gen 1 1288834974657
next 5686881485761 error
next 1288834974662 20975616
gen 1023 0
next 1750000000000 7340032000004190208
